semantics: Observed FIFO-head/free-slot eligibility until CPU preparation finishes; zero if already ready. Includes CPU queue and service, excludes full-slot and earlier-request prefill waits. Idle subset means no active/ready decode request at a blocking pull, not device-traced NPU idle. Poll-boundary measurement, not a counterfactual E2E saving; do not subtract from latency.
